verses.text: The one who smashes is coming against you! Guard the fortress, watch the road, brace yourselves, and gather all your strength!
The LORD is restoring Jacob’s glory, like Israel’s glory, after destroyers stripped them and ruined their vines.
His warriors’ shields are red, and his soldiers wear scarlet. On the day he prepares for battle, the chariots flash like steel and the spears of pine are raised.
Chariots race through the streets and rush back and forth across the open roads. They look like flaming torches and dart like lightning.
The commander calls his best troops, but they stumble as they rush. They charge toward the wall, and the protective shield is set in place.
The river gates are thrown open, and the palace falls apart.
It is settled: Nineveh will be stripped and carried away. Her servants moan like doves and beat their breasts.
For ages Nineveh was like a pool full of water, but now its people are fleeing. “Stop! Stop!” someone shouts, but no one turns back.
Take the silver! Take the gold! The treasure has no end—there are riches of every kind.
The city is emptied, stripped, and ruined. Hearts melt; knees shake; bodies tremble, and every face turns pale.
Where is the lions’ den now, the place where the young lions were fed, where lion and lioness walked with their cubs without fear?
The lion killed enough for his cubs and strangled prey for his lionesses. He filled his caves with kills and his dens with prey.

“Look, I am against you,” says the LORD of Armies. “I will burn your chariots in smoke; the sword will kill your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and your messengers will no longer be heard.”
